Whom do I call in an emergency?:
COVERED
- Call the 24x7 helpline **1800 000 1234** and tell them within **24 hours** of an emergency admission.
- Need an air ambulance? Call **1800 000 9111**; covered up to **₹2,50,000** a year for life-threatening cases, with pre-approval.
- Road ambulance is covered up to **₹3,000** per hospitalisation.
Source: page 2, page 3
Is my hospital cashless?:
NOT IN YOUR DOCUMENTS
- Cashless works only at **network hospitals**. Check the list in the Aarogya app or website, or call **1800 000 1234**.
- Planned admission: inform them **48 hours** before. Emergency: within **24 hours**.
- Show your e-card at the hospital insurance desk.
Source: page 3
I broke my wrist. What is covered?:
COVERED
- **If admitted:** covered up to your **₹10,00,000** sum insured, cashless at a network hospital. Call 1800 000 1234 within 24 hours.
- **If treated without admission** (plaster, X-ray): up to **₹5,000** a year under OPD, as reimbursement.
- Injuries from adventure sports are excluded.
Source: page 2, page 3, page 4
I need a tooth extraction. Is it covered:
PARTLY COVERED
- Covered under **OPD dental**, up to **₹10,000 a year**.
- It's **reimbursement**: pay the dentist, then claim in the app within 30 days with the bill and prescription.
- Cosmetic dentistry isn't covered.
Source: page 2, page 3
When can I use my free health check-up?:
COVERED
- One check-up every policy year, up to **₹10,000**.
- **Cashless** at partner diagnostic centres; book it in the Aarogya app.
- Your policy year runs from 1 January.
Source: page 1, page 2
